findings.description: ADR 0092 still says the ladder is written once in `src/claude/model-ladder.constants.ts`, but this PR moved that file to `src/claude/constants/model-ladder.constants.ts`, so anyone following the path finds no file there.

The `WindowTarget` JSDoc moved here unchanged. It says which name a window wears and which server it is on "are this module's to know", but in a types file "this module" now reads as the types file. It should name `session-runtime.service` instead.

process_issues.description: review-security was not spawned: the PR moves declarations without changing them and touches no trust boundary. review-simplicity was not spawned: the only new files are the role folders the stated layout convention requires. review-context, review-spec and review-workflow-safety were not spawned: there are no spec, protocol or infra surfaces, no closing issue references, and no workflow changes.
The conventions reviewer said it did not read docs/conventions/*.md, so it checked the change against the PR's stated layout rules rather than quoted convention text.
The guards reviewer did not read docs/adr/ or look for a lint-level import-boundary config. It checked scripts/check-file-layout.sh, file-layout.allow and .claude/spot-checks.tsv.
